\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
% Straight-segment excerpt from the PGF manual, "Constructing Paths".
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=2]
  \path[use as bounding box] (-.2,-.5) rectangle (2,.9);
  \draw[thick,red]
       (0,0) coordinate (a)
    -- coordinate (ab) (1,.5) coordinate (b);
  \draw (ab) node[below right] {straight segment};
  \draw[blue] (ab) -- +(0,.4);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
